name: Transport Phenomena: Gradivane
subtitle: Transport Phenomena Course
shortDescription: Learn transport phenomena by building: size a pin fin, plan a drug patch, pick a catalyst pellet. Adaptive quizzes and seven cited labs. Free with ads.
longDescription:
Transport Phenomena: Gradivane is a course app for engineering undergraduates that teaches how momentum, heat and mass move, and what the three have in common.

Learn it two ways and switch at any time. Classical follows the usual syllabus order across 24 units: fluxes and the three laws, shell balances for Couette and tube flow, power-law fluids, boundary layers, conduction and fins, transient conduction, laminar convection, diffusion, diffusion with reaction, and convective mass transfer with the Chilton-Colburn analogy. Real-world starts from something you want to make, and the theory appears at the moment you need it: design a heat-sink pin fin, plan a drug-delivery patch, size a catalyst pellet, pump a shear-thinning polymer. Finished designs are saved on your Made-it shelf.

Seven interactive labs, each tied to a cited relation and checked against a second numerical method: a boundary-layer studio with Blasius profiles and thermal layers, a space-time map of a cooling slab, a fin bench, tube-flow rheology for Newtonian and power-law fluids, a catalyst pellet with the Thiele modulus, an analogy explorer for Prandtl and Schmidt numbers, and an erfc penetration front.

Adaptive practice: 844 original questions across four levels from Beginner to Research. Numeric answers are accepted within a tolerance and every numeric answer is cross-checked by a separate numerical solver. Your mastery is tracked on the device for each concept, fades gently when you are away, and decides what is suggested next. After every quiz you get encouraging, specific feedback with links to the lesson, the lab and a free drill for what to look at next. Choose 5, 10, 20, 40 or a custom number of questions, or take a timed, ad-free mock exam.

Sources are cited and open in a full-width sheet with Back and Close. Text size goes from 50 to 300 percent on every screen. The app works offline and keeps your progress on the device.

Free with ads. Watch a short video to unlock premium features for 24 hours, or remove ads and unlock everything with a monthly subscription. Lessons, worked solutions and your progress always stay free. Payment is charged to your store account, the subscription renews monthly until cancelled in your store account settings, and the price is shown by the store before you subscribe. Restore purchases is in More.

Education only: examples use idealised models and are not a design standard for real equipment. Not affiliated with any university or textbook publisher named in the sources.
